162.news_title: 26inch 4x3 Ratio LCD Monitors for Arcade Machines
162.long_description: The 26inch Arcooda 4x3 aspect ratio arcade monitors have been designed for arcade machines, and support over 160 video resolutions in 4x3 viewing ratio. With JAMMA wiring support, color correction, and auto picture function, using 15khz, 25khz and 31khz arcade games is so easy. If you have older 26inch CRT tube arcade machines that have deteriorated, our Arcooda 26inch monitors may be the best answer. Our monitors are specifically designed to work on older 15khz, 25khz and 31khz arcade machines. Key features include; - over 160 pre-programmed video resolutions with auto picture support. - menu options for screen size adjustments - custom RGB board to allow quick color correction for any arcade game board - thicker black metal bezel for the 26inch monitor, to fill any space in arcade bezels - full viewing angle - very low monitor display lag - full metal frame, with multiple mounting options Soon we will look to release various mounting brackets to match different machine series. In these images shared on this page, we have upgraded a Midway Cruis'n World that had a very worn out CRT tube monitor. Using the existing cabinet wiring, we moved 2 of the wires in the plug, then plugged the machines video plug into our RGB board. We then connected our RGB board via the VGA cable to the monitor, once the picture displayed, press the auto button, and, that its, a new display on your Cruis'n World arcade machine. Our 4:3 ratio 26inch arcade monitor is suitable for nearly all arcade machines needing to upgrade their 26 to 29inch arcade CRT tube monitors. Choose from 2 models; 26 inch Arcooda 4:3 Ratio LCD Monitor 15khz 24khz 31khz up to 1440x1080 26 inch Arcooda 4:3 Ratio Arcade LCD Monitor 15khz 24khz 31khz up to 2880x2160
